073eac0f051ed228a874b1803539c856.overview: A woman who survived the brutal killing of her family as a child is forced to confront the events of that day.
073eac0f051ed228a874b1803539c856.tagline: In 1985, her entire family was murdered. 30 years later, the truth emerges.

075e967da83c82f104df35999b830c04.overview: One of the great raconteurs of stage and screen, Spalding Gray, came together with one of cinema’s boldest image-makers, Oscar-winning director Steven Soderbergh, for Gray’s Anatomy, a spellbinding adaptation of Gray’s 1993 monologue of the same name (cowritten with Renée Shafransky). In it, Gray, with typical sardonic relish, chronicles his arduous journey through the diagnosis and treatment of a rare and alarming ocular condition. For the monologist, this experience occasioned a meditation on illness and mortality, medicine and metaphysics; for the filmmaker, it was a chance to experiment with ways of bringing his subject’s words to brilliant, eye-opening life.
075e967da83c82f104df35999b830c04.tagline: Thrill to the minimal cystoid macula edema on the basis of capillary incompetence!

076bc3b24a5c59ecf4e70a08f4bfb916.overview: An intimate conversation between filmmakers, chronicling De Palma’s 55-year career, his life, and his filmmaking process, with revealing anecdotes and, of course, a wealth of film clips.
076bc3b24a5c59ecf4e70a08f4bfb916.tagline: Being a director is being a watcher

077202b3efc5c51fd87c91b52e8b8336.overview: Tongues begin to wag when a lonely widow becomes romantically involved with a military man. Problems arise when the gossip is filtered down to her own children.
077202b3efc5c51fd87c91b52e8b8336.tagline: Of all the dramatic triumphs from Warners this one is the greatest!

077b02c4c7895a6715cb007281d011e4.overview: Shot primarily in Wolof, this second feature by Ousmane Sembène was the first ever made in an African language—a major step toward the realization of the trailblazing Senegalese filmmaker’s dream of creating a cinema by, about, and for the inhabitants of his home continent. After jobless Ibrahima Dieng receives a money order for 25,000 francs from a nephew who works in Paris, news of his windfall quickly spreads among his neighbors, who flock to him for loans even as his attempts to cash the order are stymied in a maze of bureaucratic obstacles, and new troubles rain down on his head. One of Sembène’s most coruscatingly funny and indignant films, Mandabi—an adaptation of a novella by the director himself—is a bitterly ironic depiction of a society scarred by colonialism and plagued by corruption, greed, and poverty.

079fb397eb9aa297224673629d5361a5.overview: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spaulding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run, and very little money in the bank - not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton.
079fb397eb9aa297224673629d5361a5.tagline: The story of a woman fighting for her children, for her land, for the greatest dream there is... the future.

07cedff27bb80093bce4867a6a0d2b20.overview: The inimitable filmmaker Mike Leigh’s affection for spirited, irrepressible figures whom society too often overlooks shines through every frame of this wonderfully tender, bittersweet ode to female friendship and hard-won inner growth. Born out of the singularly collaborative, improvisational rehearsal methods that give Leigh’s characters their multidimensional richness and unforgettable spark, Career Girls features vividly idiosyncratic performances from Katrin Cartlidge and Lynda Steadman as former roommates who reunite in London six years after striking out on their own. Over the course of a weekend full of laughter, tears, memories, and chance encounters, they confront what it means to revisit the past—in the form of both wounds that haven’t fully healed and bonds that can never be broken.
07cedff27bb80093bce4867a6a0d2b20.tagline: All Hannah wanted was a roommate... instead she got a best friend.

07f03817fb71e9e951ef6fccf9b83bfa.overview: A fairy tale grounded in poignant reality, Terry Gilliam’s magnificent, Manhattan-set The Fisher King features Jeff Bridges and Robin Williams in two of their most brilliant roles. Bridges plays a former radio shock jock reconstructing his life after a scandal, and Williams a homeless man on a quest for the Holy Grail—which he believes to be hidden somewhere on the Upper East Side. Unknowingly linked by their pasts, the two men aid each other on a fanciful journey toward their own humanity. This singular American odyssey features a witty script by Richard LaGravenese, evocative cinematography by Roger Pratt, and superb supporting performances by Amanda Plummer and an Oscar-winning Mercedes Ruehl, all harnessed by Gilliam into a compassionate, funny modern-day myth.
07f03817fb71e9e951ef6fccf9b83bfa.tagline: A Modern Day Tale About The Search For Love, Sanity, Ethel Merman And The Holy Grail.

07f3aff5003266e0ae81c269f8f49eb3.overview: Middle-class housewife Kay Miniver deals with petty problems. She and her husband Clem watch her Oxford-educated son Vin court Carol Beldon, the charming granddaughter of the local nobility as represented by Lady Beldon. Then the war comes and Vin joins the RAF.
07f3aff5003266e0ae81c269f8f49eb3.tagline: "Mrs. Miniver" is more than a picture... It's dramatic. It's tender. It's human. It's real.
